heading: Engineered for zero-trust precision.
lede: DocuGuard AI operates under strict mathematical invariants: your contracts never train public models, every mutation is cryptographically signed, and every AI suggestion is backed by statutory citations.

methodology.title: Ingest with hardware-grade isolation
methodology.description: Contracts are ingested into memory-isolated environments. SHA-256 digests are computed immediately upon receipt, anchoring the document state before processing begins.

methodology.title: Frame exposure against corporate baselines
methodology.description: Clauses are evaluated against Delaware Chancery, Uniform Commercial Code, and enterprise risk thresholds. Uncapped liabilities and non-standard terms are immediately flagged.

methodology.title: Govern mutations through dual-signatory policies
methodology.description: High-risk contract transitions and bulk deadline updates require explicit policy checks. Self-approval is forbidden, and stale previews abort automatically to prevent race conditions.

methodology.title: Prove compliance with cryptographic non-repudiation
methodology.description: All actions are recorded in an append-only SHA-256 audit ledger. Evidence packages can be independently verified without contacting our servers.
